subject: English
stimulus: (a) Unless you study attentively ⎯⎯. (b) It is a long time since ⎯⎯. (c) If I have seen you ⎯⎯. (d) 1971 is the year when ⎯⎯. (e) Danger comes where ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Unless you study attentively, you cannot pass any examination. (b) It is a long time since we met last. (c) If I have seen you, I will beat you, no doubt. (d) 1971 is the year when we achieved independence. (e) Danger comes where danger is feared.
